title: Can Genesis 1 sustain a hydraulic-engineering interpretation?
question: Can the textual, linguistic, technological, chronological, and comparative evidence support or challenge the hypothesis that Genesis 1 can be interpreted as a hydraulic-engineering sequence?
scope: Genesis 1 and explicitly linked comparative evidence.
context: GEI proposes a hydraulic analogy; this investigation treats that proposal as a hypothesis rather than an established conclusion.
constraints: Do not treat graph connectivity as proof.
